title: 开源项目做到月入5位数，他说自己只是幸运
title_en: Open Source Project Hit 5-Figure Monthly, He Says He's Just Lucky
title_jp: オープンソースプロジェクトが月収5桁、運が良かっただけと語る
title_ar: مشروع مفتوح المصدر حقق 5 أرقام شهريا، يقول إنه محظوظ فقط
carouselChartTitle: 开源项目做到月入5位数，他说自己只是幸运
author: 阿星

{"ops": [{"insert": "开源项目做到月入5位数，他说自己只是幸运"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Laravel生态圈的传奇，用Livewire和AlpineJS改变了前端开发", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Caleb Porzio说自己是个"lucky fella"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做了Livewire——让Laravel开发者不用写JavaScript就能做dynamic UI。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后做了AlpineJS——轻量级JavaScript框架。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在还有Flux UI——premium UI组件库。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "月入5位数。全开源。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Caleb一直是web developer。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "给agency和产品公司工作过，但厌倦为别人工作。想要自己的项目，也不适应normal job环境。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "于是存钱、辞职、开始fun着做开源。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Livewire就emerge了。他知道大JavaScript frameworks的痛苦，想explore简化full-stack dev的方式。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "看到Phoenix LiveView，那个周末，Livewire诞生了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一年内，sponsorships就pay了他的bills。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "之后建了Alpine。再之后Flux UI。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "通过这些项目，他一直做open source，做热爱的事，还有幸pay几个好人帮忙。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""我是个幸运的家伙。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "商业模式很简单："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做免费、有价值的工具，然后卖教育课程、ebooks，现在premium UI组件。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "目前为止效果不错。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做到这点花了很多深夜和Twitter post。加上heaps of passion和time delve into it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "技术栈当然用Livewire。主要在Laravel ecosystem里工作，因为那是他的home。不过AlpineJS reached broader audience。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "起步阶段他已经有audience了——在Laravel community里。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在几个conference演讲过，在space里一家popular agency工作过。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这真的很重要。有了solid base，他向已经trust他的人分享自己在做什么。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的natural charisma也是巨大优势——build关系、conference演讲、写engaging emails。Podcasts也帮了很多。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""如果我不擅长沟通，不是那种'natural'，会难得多。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最大的挑战是其他open source工具的竞争。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Open source很难有real moat。一切都freely available供参考。好idea一catch on，很多人自然想做同样或类似的事。必须always push envelope、stay relevant，这很exhausting。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "另一个hurdle是Livewire是个funky tool。当时countercultural，需要significant time和convincing让很多人接受。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他never stop preaching，最终won越来越多人over。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "向周围人学习也是重要优势。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他从Taylor Otwell那里学到很多关于craft和product的东西——不是通过instruction，而是通过observation。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Adam Wathan也greatly influenced他。他的thinking和写的关于sales、entrepreneurship的材料invaluable。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "六、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的建议？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""Keep it real。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "听周围的signals。人们经常tell你他们想要什么，但surprisingly hard to listen to them和follow through。Crucial to stay grounded in real user demand。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Always ask："What do my users need/want？" Better yet，ASK THEM！他们会directly或indirectly tell you。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Also，"}, {"insert": "DON'T SPEND MONEY！", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果keep operation simple，你能make so much more money。Life expenses不要随着收入增加而creep up。不要quick to hire people。Do as much yourself as you can，把cash stock away在investment account，万一shit hits the fan，你come out on top。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "七、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Caleb想realize tools的full vision。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "想build最comprehensive、robust、productive的web stack out there。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "已经come a long way，但还有way to go才能cover all fronts。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "AI could be huge for their tools如果play it right——所以和每个人一样，那是现在big thing to figure out。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Caleb的故事是开源创业者的dream。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做热爱的事，community支持，收入体面。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他强调的不是技术多牛，而是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Charisma + communication + listening to users。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有财务自律：不急着扩张，不急着花钱，保持lean。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在开源世界里，moat很难建立。能保护你的，只有持续创新和社区信任。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Caleb做到了。而且他很清楚自己的幸运。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这种humility，也是成功的一部分。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: Open source project achieved five figure monthly income he says he is just lucky. Legend of Laravel ecosystem changed frontend development with Livewire and AlpineJS. Caleb Porzio says he is lucky fella. Made Livewire lets Laravel developers do dynamic UI without writing JavaScript. Then made AlpineJS lightweight JavaScript framework. Now also has Flux UI premium UI component library. Five figure monthly income. All open source. One. Caleb has always been web developer. Worked for agency and product companies but tired of working for others. Wanted his own projects also not adapt to normal job environment. So saved money quit job started fun making open source. Livewire emerged. He knew big JavaScript frameworks pain wanted explore simplify full stack dev way. Saw Phoenix LiveView that weekend Livewire born. Within a year sponsorships paid his bills. Then built Alpine. Then Flux UI. Through these projects he kept.
